# PostgreSQL + ent; migrations generated by Atlas and applied by goose

User data and editorial data live in PostgreSQL (version 19 once it is GA, otherwise 18). Access goes through ent (schema written in Go, code generated automatically). Migrations are SQL files in goose format, generated by `atlas migrate diff` from the ent schema at dev time and committed to the repo. The binary embeds goose and applies migrations at startup, so production does not need Atlas installed.

Postgres runs in the same stack, following the existing app + Postgres stack template on the VPS (internal network only, with a healthcheck, using a named volume).

## Considered Options

- SQLite + Litestream: cheaper, but Litestream 0.5 has no production-readiness statement yet, and the operator is already familiar with Postgres.
- ent auto-migrate at startup (`Schema.Create`): no migration files to review, dangerous with real data.
- sqlc instead of ent: rejected by the operator's choice.
